name: word-push
title: Word Push
description: Words drive in from the right and push the line left into its new center.
useWhen: A single tagline or closing phrase should build word by word with physical, push-driven motion.
The first word glides in to center and is shoved left as each next word arrives from the right.
avoidWhen: Several phrases must play in sequence with cuts: use word-stream.
You want a calm, driftless word-by-word entrance: use per-word-crossfade.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: A single phrase that builds word by word.

variables.label: Word gap
variables.description: Frames before the second word arrives (30 fps).

variables.label: Acceleration
variables.description: Each gap is this fraction of the previous one: below 1 the words speed up.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.
